description: Use this when you need fresh web results for a query: live web search API for agents that returns title, URL, snippet, source and date for each result. Pass query. Live quote: upstream price plus the BitTuitive fee max(20%, 3 sats), typically under $0.01. Unpaid calls return an L402 invoice and an x402 quote. Same as call_routed_api(capability="web_search"). Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Or prepay at /api/v1/credits (Bearer btf_ token) or add ?bt_pass=1 for a 5-minute pass. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Example: search_web(query="latest bitcoin ETF flows") Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

credit.description: 24h credit token from an earlier failed search_web call.

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
